releases.notes:
Veltraph development snapshot for Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Fabric API, and Java 25.

Includes the compiled mod JAR and SHA-256 checksum. Source is available at commit `5108b3db5f75`.

Validation: `./gradlew test build` passed with 8,447 tests across 1,103 suites, with zero failures, errors, or skips. This standalone repository excludes private captured-world fixtures and diagnostic data.

Active development: features have different levels of testing, and some workflows remain incomplete. This release has not been newly validated in Minecraft or on a live server. See the README for setup and current limitations.
